verbatim_quote: The venv lives in a per-session temporary directory. It is NOT durable and NOT reproducible from this path alone. It is recorded so HQ can see exactly what executed. The reproducible content is the freeze below, not the path.

hq182s_wording_characterisation_is_wrong.actual_wording: NOT reproducible from this path alone
hq182s_wording_characterisation_is_wrong.difference_matters: The record explicitly disclaims PATH reproducibility and then supplies a pinned recipe plus a statement that the reproducible content is the freeze, not the path. HQ182's wording would have implied the record offered no reproducibility basis at all, which is the opposite of what the file says.
hq182s_wording_characterisation_is_wrong.verdict: C2 UPHELD on the wording point

components.evidence: environment_location.base_interpreter_sha256_prefix32 = 11d6f541a870a141249ce98d45834a67 — a 32-hex-character (16-byte) prefix, not a complete SHA-256.
components.consequence: Even if the recipe is followed exactly, the record cannot prove the resulting interpreter is byte-identical to the qualified one, because only a prefix was retained.
components.also_relevant: The five compiled_extensions entries are likewise 32-hex prefixes of .so digests, with no prefix marker in the field name, so a consumer reading only the key cannot tell they are truncated.

components.evidence: reproduce_command pins 13 packages but NOT narwhals. The lock itself records narwhals==2.26.0 as an addition beyond the historical seed, described as pulled transitively by pyarrow 25.0.1.
components.consequence: The recipe does not fully determine the resolved environment. A re-resolve could select a different narwhals, which would change the freeze hash.
components.mitigation_already_in_the_record: narwhals is off the C4 import closure and absent from the authoritative court, so the qualification result is unaffected; only the hash moves.

residual_class.why_not_pure_fingerprint_incompleteness: The packet names only one class. Naming both is more accurate and does not change the blocker: the fingerprint gap is the one that prevents proving interpreter identity, while the narwhals gap only perturbs a hash for a package that is provably off the C4 path.
residual_class.why_not_pure_environment_irreproducibili: The record never claims the environment is irreproducible. It affirmatively supplies a pinned recipe and states the reproducible content is the freeze. Reading irreproducibility into it would repeat the C1 pattern of inferring a claim the source does not make.

failure_mode_check.why: The quotation was taken from the complete file at a pinned commit, whose blob is identical at 1df64cc59 and at the freeze. The substring checks were run against the whole serialised document, not a truncated grep result. No value in this finding was reconstructed by inference.

scope_note: This finding re-checks the R7 wording and its residual classification only. It does not re-adjudicate the freeze, re-run any test, or lift HQ182's hold.
